mapper.select: SELECT D.USER_ID, D.USER_NAME, D.USER_NICKNAME, D.USER_CREATED_AT, L.ROLES_ID, L.LOGIN_ID FROM user_detail D JOIN user_login L ON D.USER_ID = L.USER_ID LIMIT #{searchVO.rowStart}, #{searchVO.displayRowCount}

SELECT D.USER_ID, D.USER_NAME, D.USER_NICKNAME, D.USER_CREATED_AT, L.ROLES_ID, S.SANCTIONS_TYPES FROM user_detail D JOIN user_login L ON D.USER_ID = L.USER_ID LEFT JOIN sanctions S ON D.USER_ID = S.USER_ID

SELECT D.USER_ID, D.USER_NAME, D.USER_NICKNAME, D.USER_GENDER, D.USER_BIRTH, D.USER_CREATED_AT, D.USER_TEL, D.USER_ZIPCODE, D.USER_ADDR, D.USER_EMAIL, D.USER_IMG, L.ROLES_ID, L.LOGIN_ID, S.SANCTIONS_TYPES FROM user_detail D JOIN user_login L ON D.USER_ID = L.USER_ID LEFT JOIN sanctions S ON D.USER_ID = S.USER_ID WHERE D.USER_ID = #{param1}
